guarantees.claim: fsm_digest_done_q is cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low; otherwise it follows fsm_digest_done_d on every posedge clk_i.
guarantees.cond: every posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni

assumptions.claim: fsm_digest_done_d must be driven to a known, stable logic value when rst_ni is inactive, otherwise fsm_digest_done_q may capture an undefined state.
assumptions.risk: propagation of X into the digest-done indicator, potentially corrupting downstream status logic.
